summary: Frontend-only testing of Decision Trace tab on ApplicationDetail. Verified tab placement, 6 stage nodes, per-node detail panels, and regression across other tabs. Empty-state case (BluePeak LS-2026-00126) could not be verified because that seed app currently has a Reject decision in this environment.
action_items: Seed data note: BluePeak Traders LS-2026-00126 now has a 'Reject' decision in the running environment, so the trace-empty state cannot be exercised on it. If empty-state UX matters for QA, either add/keep a fresh app with no decision, or re-seed. The empty-state code path (data-testid trace-empty + trace-run-btn) was code-reviewed and looks correct; unable to visually verify in this env.
critical_code_review_comments: DecisionTraceTab.js line 70: decision.pd_score * 100 will throw if pd_score is null/undefined. Guard with (decision.pd_score||0). Same for line 85: decision.decision.toUpperCase() will throw if decision.decision is missing. In practice decision object always has these when non-null, but defensive checks recommended.
Line 229: Math.max(...wf.map(...)) with wf empty would give -Infinity; already guarded via Math.max(..., 1) — good.
documents prop is not defaulted; if undefined would crash on documents.length (line 59). Parent always passes an array, but a default of `documents = []` in the destructure would be safer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trace tab verified end-to-end on Arvind LS-2026-00124 (approved): tab appears between Decision and Credit Memo, 6 nodes trace-node-{documents,extraction,brain,policy,structuring,decision} render with labels/summaries/status dots. Detail panel (trace-detail) updates correctly on each node click showing: documents list, financials rows, PD/Grade/FOIR/DSCR + positive/risk signals, policy rules with PASS/FAIL + triggered IDs, waterfall bars + ROI/tenure/EMI/post-FOIR, final decision word + amounts/authority. All other tabs (overview/documents/brain/policy/decision/memo/ask/audit) render without console errors. Empty state not exercisable because BluePeak LS-2026-00126 is currently 'Rejected' in this env (still renders the 6-node trace correctly with red statuses).
